specification.title: STL Tessellation Export Codec
specification.goal: BRep to watertight STL through shared tessellator
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Save/load native document đầy đủ geometry/history/layer/gem instance; xuất STL watertight và báo lỗi hình học.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không xây thêm 3DM reader trong codec native; không làm STEP/IGES ở giai đoạn này.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “STL Tessellation Export Codec” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: save/reload or import transaction preserves object IDs, units, layer assignments and declared metadata.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.
specification.execution_status: SPEC_ONLY; NOT READY TO CODE UNTIL M00 AND TASK L4 AUDIT

runtime_implementation.surface_source_worker_2026_11_13: STL worker copies NURBS surface source and optional trim extension together, releases document after handoff, and shares repeated source occurrences. runtime_implementation.shared_authored_mesh_worker_2026_11_13: Repeated authored-mesh occurrences share one admitted worker snapshot and one pending allowance; two placed instances including reflection match retained-document STL soup. runtime_implementation.mixed_brep_authored_mesh_worker_2026_11_: Tested mixed OCCT B-rep and authored mesh selections copy admitted mesh source on the export worker, then release the captured document; soup and binary match document capture and an STL worker export completed. Document remains pinned during copying; repeated mesh occurrences duplicate source and surfaces still use document capture. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-13-stl-brep-authored-mesh-worker.md
runtime_implementation.trim_native_headroom_2026_11_13: Conversions of tested 129–1024-edge trims request estimated native headroom before OCCT; constrained managed-memory fixtures preserve destination/document/Redo and retry. The allowance is heuristic, not a native-memory bound. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-12-trimmed-surface-stl-gap.md#estimated-native-headroom-for-large-trim-export

Whole-process lifetime counters; OCCT-only peak and worst case unverified. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-12-trimmed-surface-stl-gap.md#process-memory-for-the-1024-edge-fixtures
runtime_implementation.trim_stl_1024_2026_11_13: Tested reopened plane and cylinder trims with up to 1024 edges export source-derived STL at two profiles; pressure and 1025-edge refusal preserve destination/document/Redo. Native transient peak, desktop and broad geometry unverified. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-12-trimmed-surface-stl-gap.md#export-up-to-1024-polygon-edges

document_stl_export_2026_11_01.scope: File > Export Selected writes one binary STL in millimetres from selected meshes, editable B-Reps (shared OCCT re-tessellation), retained NativeBrep payloads (re-imported through the OCCT bridge, not the display mesh) and NurbsSurfaces (adaptive 8-128 chord grid). Inputs are placed, welded, pole-degenerates removed; closed sets are strict and open surfaces report open edges. The destination is replaced atomically.
